name: +1 Wings For Eggs
desc:
Welcome to +1 Wings for Eggs 🪽🥚

Fly higher, go farther, and hatch as many Animals as you can! Use your growing flight speed to reach new areas, discover better Eggs, and hatch rare Animals! 🐾✨

How to play:
🕊️ Fly your way across each area
🥚 Find & Hatch Eggs for Animals
⚡ Gain +1 Flight Speed as you progress
🐶 Collect rare Animals to earn more Cash
💵 Upgrade your Animals to boost your income
🏗️ Expand your base to hold even more Animals

💤 Your Animals generate Cash even while OFFLINE!

♻️ Rebirth to multiply your Cash and fly even farther!

👍 Like the game and join the group for a FREE Animal!
